note: The two sets are essentially identical in the shown claims: all values, bindings and quotes match the page (equipment schedule tags DW/RF/CT/WO/EX/CW/CD/TV and the furniture schedule rows F1–F10). The only difference is that Set B adds 'location: KITCHEN' as a condition to the COOKTOP and REFRIGERATOR manufacturer claims, which is true on the page but not a condition the manufacturer value depends on. Neither set misreads or invents anything, so the added conditions neither help nor materially hurt Set B.
remarks: The text layer garbles the PLUMBING SCHEDULE block (labels cut to 'DESCRIPTIO', 'MANUFACTU'), and the image is cropped at the right edge, so plumbing fixture data (SK, F1, WC, F2, SV, SH) cannot be verified from this part; both sets appear to avoid claiming from it. Set B's habit of attaching the row's location as a 'condition' on unconditional attributes (manufacturer) is a mild pattern worth normalizing, since location is a separate attribute rather than a condition of the manufacturer value.
